profile.headline: Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase
profile.summary: I am currently an undergraduate at the University of Michigan, planning to graduate in May 2020 with a Bachelor's of Science in Computer Science. I love programming and have completed projects using Python, C++, C, and most recently the Ionic and Angular 7 Javascript frameworks. I am always working to learn new skills and improve my coding ability, both inside and outside of the classroom.
